key_insight: ART of PIV uses a learned agent to select a measurement pipeline for each particle-image pair, improving velocity estimates within a specified speed budget.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive PIV can improve flow-control feedback as conditions change without relying on one fixed, expert-tuned configuration.
method: Build a library of PIV configurations for a specified speed budget.
Learn per-image-pair selection to optimize a chosen measurement objective.
Adapt estimator tuning or regions of interest for flow measurement and control.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 12.2–22.4% lower average end-point error than the best single estimator at matched speed, gains extending to 1,000–4,000 image pairs/s, and a 13.24–13.59 percentage-point reduction in simulated mean normalized closed-loop cost, plus physical flow-tracking demonstrations.
watch_item: Performance depends on the available configuration library and training coverage; robustness to unseen flow and imaging conditions requires validation.
paper_title: ART of PIV: Agentic Real-Time Particle Image Velocimetry for Active Flow Control
